days.title: Tracing basic strokes
days.description: Print out some free calligraphy practice sheets online. Use a pencil to trace basic upstrokes and downstrokes.
days.tip: Maintain consistent pressure for thin upstrokes and thick downstrokes, even with a pencil

days.title: Brush pen fundamentals
days.description: Grab your brush pen. Practice basic upstrokes (light pressure) and downstrokes (heavy pressure) on your paper pad.
days.tip: Only the very tip of the brush pen should touch the paper for thin lines

days.title: Mastering the 'o' stroke
days.description: Practice the oval shape by combining a light upstroke and a heavy downstroke. Focus on smooth transitions.
days.tip: Rotate your paper if it helps you achieve a smoother curve

days.title: Lowercase 'a' and 'b'
days.description: Combine basic strokes to form lowercase 'a' and 'b'. Pay attention to entry and exit strokes.
days.tip: Lift your pen completely between strokes for cleaner letter connections

days.title: Connecting letters
days.description: Practice connecting two simple letters like 'at' or 'be'. Maintain consistent spacing.
days.tip: The exit stroke of one letter becomes the entry stroke of the next

days.title: Your first short word
days.description: Write a short word like 'hello' or 'love'. Focus on consistent letter size and spacing.
days.tip: Lightly sketch the word in pencil first if you're unsure of spacing

days.title: Week 1 review & reflection
days.description: Look at all your practice sheets. Identify one letter or stroke you improved on and one you want to focus on next week.
days.tip: Keep all your practice sheets to track your progress over time
